Assistant Testing Engineer Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Testing Engineer

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an Assistant Testing Engineer to support electrical testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and documentation of electrical systems and equipment.


Responsibilities


	Assist with HV/MV/LV, transformer, relay, CT/PT, switchgear, motor, generator, UPS, and battery charger testing.
	Support troubleshooting of control panels, MCCs, motors, generators, and DBs.
	Use testing equipment such as Megger, Omicron, and Primary Injection Test Kits
	Prepare test reports and commissioning documentation.
	Work on-site, including extended hours or shifts when required.


Requirements


	HND / B.Sc. in Electrical/Electrical Engineering or related field.
	0–2 year of  relevant experience.
	Basic knowledge of electrical testing and commissioning.
	Strong troubleshooting skills and willingness to work on-site.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Human Resources Associate Job at Renewable Energy Technology Training Institute (RETTI)




        
    

        
        Renewable Energy Technology Training Institute (RETTI) was established to train, mentor, and provide work experience for youths who will drive the energy transition as skilled workers for the renewable energy industry and as entrepreneurs who directly deploy clean energy solutions. We equip clean energy technicians, developers, engineers, and employees. Research has shown the gap in the technical know-how of renewable energy engineers and handsmen. If people are trained on proper renewable energy technology design, its applications, and entrepreneurship, it will promote environmental sustainability and improve the economy through the creation of jobs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Human Resources Associate

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Job Description


	The Human Resources Associate is a full-time, hybrid role based in AJAH, with some flexibility for work from home. The role involves supporting daily HR operations, including employee onboarding, record management, and HR documentation.
	The Human Resources Associate will coordinate recruitment activities, assist with performance management processes, and help organize training and development programs.
	The position also includes responding to employee inquiries, maintaining HR systems, preparing HR reports, and ensuring compliance with company policies and relevant regulations.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline with 1-2 years of HR experience.
	Proficiency in HRIS systems and the Microsoft/Google Office Suite.
	Basic knowledge of HR policies, employment laws, and labour regulations.
	Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
	High level of integrity with the ability to handle confidential information discreetly.
	Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
	Proactive, supportive, and a team-oriented mindset.
	Commitment to fostering a collaborative and productive team environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
